knownGaps.evidence: PetAvatar skips aura preload and removes aura IDs from modular composition.
knownGaps.minimalFix: Allow registered aura entries through preload/compose; keep only unregistered auras on the legacy placement path. Preserve the same rear/base/.../front ordering.

knownGaps.evidence: previewFigure must use a canvas compositor with the same erase/frontErase destination-out passes as PetAvatar.
knownGaps.minimalFix: Build/cache the preview frame from the same composed atlas canvas used by PetAvatar; CSS stacking alone cannot reproduce erase/frontErase.

knownGaps.evidence: Batch publish args hard-code frontErase to "-" and the solver has no independent frontErase output.
knownGaps.minimalFix: Add an explicit, separately sourced frontErase input/QA stage; never infer it from the composite. Keep it optional for categories that do not require late anatomical masking.
